scope: A770 16GB, E5-2696 v4, oneAPI 2025.3.2 / oneMKL 2025.3; opt-in GPU widening only
candidate: Retain one independent output allocation per Gemm; grow only when needed; keep input/output copies, FP32 GEMM, padding fallbacks and final wait.
decision: Screen failed. No runtime source, production executable or configuration changes from this experiment.
rule_before_measurement: Before measurement: primary cases are existing batch-check shapes with T>=22 (6 per dtype). Each dtype in each of two candidate rounds requires >=3% geometric mean gain, all adjacent baseline drifts <=3%, no case below -2%, and exact output hashes for all 16 shapes. T=4 probes are diagnostic controls. Passing screen needs independent confirmation and a model check.
checks_scope: Both builds widening OFF/ON, >4GiB shared arena normal/large shapes, timing-harness guards and ranges. All mismatched_cases=0; all 16 batch-shape output hashes agree across five processes.
measurement: Complete synchronous GEMM API, warmed runtime. T=4 probes: median of 5 batches x 16 calls. Existing batch check: median of 7 batches x 3 calls. Caller W/X/Y and workspace outside timing; baseline per-call output allocation/free inside timing. Cached growth is warmed before timing.
limitations: Operator screen only; no model prefill/decode/TTFT or broad quality result.
The existing batch harness prints its medians without the seven individual batch samples. Only the 30 T=4 diagnostic medians can be independently recomputed from archived batch samples.
FP16 N=2560 K=640 T=40 second comparison has 3.0696% adjacent-baseline drift, beyond the 3% gate; retained in descriptive statistics and not accepted.
Results use the existing native USM allocator pool; no general conclusion about other backends, drivers or allocator settings.
